risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies-Related Legal Requirements Identification, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Loss of Authorization / Certification / License (R-EX-11), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Assigned Responsibilities for AI & Autonomous Technologies
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to define and differentiate roles and responsibilities for:
(1) Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) configurations; and
(2) Oversight of AAT systems.
compensating_control_1.justification: Assigned Responsibilities for AI & Autonomous Technologies (AAT-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies-Related Legal Requirements Definition (AAT-04.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to assign one or more qualified individuals with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
compensating_control_2.justification: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities (GOV-05) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies-Related Legal Requirements Definition (AAT-04.1) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
